BiblicalUsage: Azaniah was one of those who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, putting his name to the promise that Israel would keep God's law. He appears once, in the list of signers, and his name is enough — he stood and signed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a signature can be an act of faith, and Azaniah's is one of the quiet ones — he signed the covenant and went home to keep it.
